retrievalProfile.description: A multi-subject composition divided into equal vertical panels, each featuring a unique person against a distinct textured background.
excludeWhen: a single continuous background is required
subjects must interact with each other across panels

recipe.visualDefinition: A composite image consisting of six narrow vertical columns. Each column contains a full-waist or full-body portrait of a different individual. The backgrounds behind each person are distinct, ranging from weathered wood and brick to patterned wallpaper and painted metal, creating a rhythmic, textured sequence.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical segmentation creates a rhythmic repetition across the frame
Individual subjects are centered within their respective narrow strips
Diverse background textures provide high contrast between adjacent panels
Consistent eye-level perspective unifies the disparate subjects
coreInvariants: Distinct background texture for every segment

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subjects are centered horizontally within their strips, scaled to show from the waist or hips up to the head.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central subjects (columns 3 and 4) act as the primary focus, though the eye naturally scans from left to right.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye moves horizontally across the vertical bars, comparing the different outfits and background textures.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with subjects and varied textures.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Eclectic mix of urban tones (brick red, weathered blue, wood brown)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: High-contrast clothing (black, white, yellow) against textured backgrounds
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Saturated pops of color like the red siding or teal belt
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Medium saturation with a wide range of values, emphasizing the gritty texture of the backgrounds.
paletteRestrictions: Maintain distinct color identities for each vertical strip

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate six distinct vertical textures: red corrugated metal, peeling blue paint on white, weathered brick, pink brick with palm fronds, floral wallpaper, and dark wood grain.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place a different person in a casual, indie-style outfit in the center of each vertical texture strip, ensuring they are cropped from the waist up.

verificationChecks: Are there exactly six vertical segments?
Does each segment have a unique background texture?
Is there one person per segment?

mustRedesign: Avoid using the same background for more than one strip
Ensure subjects do not overlap the vertical boundaries of their strips
postGenerationChecks: Verify that each strip is of equal width.
Check that the backgrounds are visually distinct from one another.
Ensure no text or logos are present on the clothing.
Confirm the subjects are all facing forward or slightly angled toward the viewer.
recipe.reuseFormula: Create a [number] panel vertical collage where each panel features a [subject type] against a [texture type] background, maintaining a [style] aesthetic.
